name: Grant Review Panel
description: Evaluation panel template for grants, fellowships, awards, accelerators, and funding decisions.

sections.title: Application Context
sections.instruction: Grant program, applicant or proposal ID, reviewers, conflict declarations, and funding amount requested

sections.title: Proposal Summary
sections.instruction: Summarize the applicant's goal, target population, approach, requested support, and expected outcomes

sections.title: Evaluation Scores
sections.instruction: Capture scores, criteria, reviewer rationale, and any spread or disagreement among reviewers

sections.title: Strengths
sections.instruction: List proposal strengths, evidence quality, feasibility, team credibility, and potential impact

sections.title: Concerns & Conditions
sections.instruction: List concerns, missing evidence, budget issues, eligibility questions, or conditions for funding

sections.title: Panel Deliberation
sections.instruction: Summarize major discussion points, disagreements, recusal notes, and consensus-building process

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.instruction: State funding recommendation, amount, conditions, ranking, and follow-up actions
